cleaner.label: Gemini CLI (AI)
cleaner.description: Local history and sessions of Gemini CLI, per project.

option.label: Project logs
option.description: Deletes the logs.json files in the projects' temporary folders.
option.warning: Logs may contain conversation content and diagnostics.

option.label: Saved conversations
option.description: Deletes the JSON and JSONL files saved in each project's chats folder.
option.warning: Deleted sessions cannot be resumed. Use gemini --list-sessions and --delete-session for selective deletion.

option.label: Shell command history
option.description: Deletes the shell command archives of each project.

option.label: Checkpoints and snapshots (advanced)
option.description: Deletes the checkpoint Git snapshots managed by Gemini CLI.
option.warning: You will lose the ability to restore changes through Gemini CLI checkpoints.
